第8章 试验术法-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

吴姜翻了个大大的白眼，忍不住吐槽出声：“不是吧？这么辛苦跑一趟地府，又是送游魂、又是走流程的，居然就给10点贡献点？这也太抠门了吧！”

吐槽归吐槽，但脸上的笑意却藏都藏不住，嘴角一直偷偷上扬着。

吴姜又想起了刚才神魂归位时，体内那股莫名涌动的热流，连忙盘膝坐好，闭上眼睛，凝神运转《幽冥炼魂诀》。

随着功法缓缓运转，他清晰地感觉到，体内的魂力比之前充盈了些许，运转速度也快了一丝，虽然提升的幅度不大，但确确实实有了进步，绝非错觉。

“真的变强了！”吴姜猛地睁开眼，眼里满是惊喜，嘴角直接扬到了耳根，“看来第一次完成任务，除了那10点贡献点，还有这种隐藏修炼奖励，不错不错！”

此刻的他，对阴差这份“兼职”越来越有兴趣——既不用花费太多时间，不耽误正常生活，还能顺便修炼提升自己，偶尔还能见识到阳间见不到的景象，简直是一举多得的美事。

这会儿第一次抓鬼的兴奋劲还没过去，虽说已经是深夜，可却半点睡意都没有，一边刷着手机消磨时间，一边心里痒痒的：不知道下次任务什么时候来，他已经有点迫不及待了。

只是，接下来两天都是风平浪静，吴姜除了日常修炼，就是陪着几个义子打游戏、侃大山，闲得都快发霉了。

这天晚上八点多，吴姜戴着耳机，正和游戏里的队友、对手热火朝天地对骂拉扯，心神突然传来一阵悸动，地府又来新的任务了！

吴姜眼睛瞬间一亮，哪里还顾得上游戏，赶忙在对话框里甩了一句“急事下线”，不顾对面队友的哀嚎和对手的嘲讽，麻溜地退出游戏。

阴差令牌自动从体内飞出，伸指一点，一条新的任务出现在了脑海之中。

“三等鬼差吴姜，请于十二个时辰之内收服苍名县老城区甜水井街游魂。”

伴随着任务的提示，还有游魂的信息。

游魂信息：姓名：王浩，男，42岁，无业游民，沉迷赌博，欠下巨额网贷及高利贷，无力偿还，被催收人员逼至走投无路，从楼顶不慎踩空，坠楼身亡。因怨气较重，滞留人间化为游魂。

Wu Jiang rolled his eyes and couldn't help but complain: "Isn't it right? It's so hard to go to the underworld to send wandering souls and go through the process, but only 10 contribution points are given? This is too stingy!"

Complaints are complaints, but the smile on his face could not be hidden, and the corners of his mouth kept secretly rising.

Wu Jiang recalled the inexplicable surge of heat in his body just now when his soul returned to its original position. He quickly sat cross-legged, closed his eyes, and concentrated on the "Netherworld Soul Refining Technique".

As the technique slowly moved, he clearly felt that the soul power in his body was a little fuller than before, and the speed was also a little faster. Although the improvement was not large, there was indeed progress, and it was definitely not an illusion.

"You've really become stronger!" Wu Jiang opened his eyes suddenly, his eyes full of surprise, and the corners of his mouth raised directly to his ears, "It seems that for completing the mission for the first time, in addition to the 10 contribution points, there is also this hidden training reward, which is not bad!"

At this moment, he is becoming more and more interested in the "part-time job" of Yinzai - it does not require too much time, does not delay normal life, can also practice and improve himself, and occasionally see scenes that cannot be seen in the world of the world. It is simply a beautiful thing.

At this moment, the excitement of catching ghosts for the first time has not passed. Although it is already late at night, he is not sleepy at all. While killing time on his mobile phone, he feels itchy in his heart: he doesn't know when the next mission will come, and he can't wait.

However, the next two days were uneventful. Apart from daily practice, Wu Jiang spent time playing games and chatting with his adopted sons. He was so idle that he almost felt moldy.

At about eight o'clock that night, Wu Jiang was wearing headphones and was having a heated exchange of words with his teammates and opponents in the game. Suddenly, there was a throbbing in his mind, and there was a new mission in the underworld!

Wu Jiang's eyes suddenly lit up. He couldn't care less about the game. He hurriedly said "Offline due to emergency" in the dialog box. He ignored the wails of his teammates and the taunts of his opponents and quickly quit the game.

The Yin difference token flew out of the body automatically. He stretched his finger and a new task appeared in his mind.

"Third-class ghost messenger Wu Jiang, please subdue the wandering spirits of Tianshuijing Street in the old city of Cangming County within twelve hours."

Along with the task prompts, there is also information about the wandering souls.

Wandering Soul Information: Name: Wang Hao, male, 42 years old, unemployed, addicted to gambling, owed huge amounts of online loans and loan sharks, unable to repay, was forced to the point of desperation by debt collectors, accidentally stepped off the roof of the building, and fell to his death.Because of his heavy resentment, he stayed in the world and became a wandering spirit.
